name: Off air
description: A navy television with rabbit-ear antennas shows broadcast colour bars, castellations and a black-level strip, with a station-ident box holding a small open book.
choices: The colour-bar test pattern reads as television at any size; the ident box carries the diary as the channel logo
Bars are pulled toward ochre, teal, plum and brick so the screen stays clear of neon cyan and magenta
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
